title: Cited Web Sources in LLM Answers about Brands: A Multilingual Audit
abstract: arXiv:2606.25787v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Displayed citations make part of generative search observable, but they do not reveal its complete retrieval process. This audit covers three archived datasets containing 167,551 URL-bearing citation entries across 128 brands, 13 languages and 12 home markets. In the principal Nordic-Baltic component, 3,863 of 21,033 registrable domains account for 80% of 131,514 citations. Wikipedia leads in 11 of 12 query languages. A recovered, separate brand-associated website classification retains 131,512 entries: 108,410 (82.4%) fall outside its brand-associated category and 23,102 (17.6%) inside. This classification does not establish legal ownership. In the full 57-brand Polish aggregate, four recruitment hosts receive 637 citations against 297 for Polish Wikipedia. The results show why normalization, classification rules and denominators belong in citation audits. They describe displayed links without estimating causal effects on bran

translated_title: 大语言模型品牌相关回答中引用的网络来源：一项多语言审计
translated_abstract: 显示出的引用使生成式搜索的一部分变得可观察，但它们并不能揭示其完整的检索过程。本次审计涵盖三个存档数据集，包含167,551条带有URL的引用条目，涉及128个品牌、13种语言和12个本土市场。在主要的北欧-波罗的海部分中，21,033个可注册域名中有3,863个占131,514次引用的80%。维基百科在12种查询语言中的11种中居于领先地位。一份恢复的、独立的品牌相关网站分类保留了131,512条条目：其中108,410条（82.4%）不属于其品牌相关类别，23,102条（17.6%）属于该类别。该分类并不能确立法律所有权。在完整的57个品牌的波兰语汇总数据中，四个招聘网站共获得637次引用，而波兰语维基百科仅为297次。这些结果说明了为什么标准化、分类规则和分母在引用审计中不可或缺。它们描述的是显示出的链接，而并未估计对品牌的因果影响（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究对涵盖128个品牌、13种语言和12个市场的167,551条大语言模型回答中的引用网址进行了多语言审计，揭示了引用来源的高度集中性（少数域名占80%的引用且维基百科占据主导地位），并论证了标准化、分类规则和明确分母在引用审计中的必要性。
en_tdlr: A multilingual audit of 167,551 citations in LLM answers about brands across 128 brands, 13 languages, and 12 home markets reveals highly concentrated citation sources—with Wikipedia dominating in 11 of 12 query languages—and demonstrates why normalization, classification rules, and denominators are essential in citation audits.
